summary.text: Jacob Burnett, 30, of Middleton, an independent write-in candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for governor of Idaho to Brad Little.

paragraphs.text: Burnett lists his hometown as Middleton and his occupation as self-employed.
He says he has lived in Idaho for 30 years.

During the campaign, his stated priorities were agency audits and lobbying transparency, lowering personal property taxes and slowing speculative out-of-state development, and expanded telehealth and parental choice in education.
Burnett lost to Brad Little, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
